note: Facts from model repositories, Hugging Face cards and framework code; see docs/model-input-survey.md for the full sourced report.

licence.code: MIT (NASA-IMPACT/Prithvi-EO-2.0 repo); the prithvi_mae.py file on Hugging Face and in TerraTorch carries an Apache-2.0 header

inputs.bands: 6 HLS bands: Blue, Green, Red, Narrow NIR, SWIR 1, SWIR 2 (HF config names B02–B07; TerraTorch HLSBands names)
inputs.units: Scaled reflectance implied by statistics (means ~1000–2700); exact scale factor UNVERIFIED

normalisation.stats: mean/std in HF config.json and TerraTorch constants

inputs.input_size: 224 default; positional embedding interpolated for other sizes

temporal.max_steps: any T (positional embedding recomputed); TL temporal encoding uses num_frames set at build
temporal.date_encoding: TL variants: [year, day-of-year] per frame; 1–365 on the model card, 0–364 in TerraTorch docs

inputs.location: TL variants: 2 values; order conflicts: prithvi_mae.py docstring says lat, lon; HF inference.py passes lnglat() (lon, lat); TerraTorch docs example also swaps them

outputs.type: all transformer blocks, (B, 1+L, D) with CLS

inputs.bands: S2L2A 12 bands incl. B9 water vapour, no cirrus (TerraTorch); S1 VV, VH; DEM
inputs.units: Implied DN-scale S2, dB S1 from statistics; UNVERIFIED
inputs.input_size: 224 default; H, W divisible by 16; positional embedding interpolated

temporal.max_steps: single frame; TerraTorch TemporalWrapper pools over time

inputs.location: optional coords modality (lon, lat), tokenised as text

outputs.type: all blocks (B, N, D), no CLS; modality merge mean/max/concat/dict
outputs.notes: IBM recommends layers [5,11,17,23] for large; PANGAEA uses [7,11,15,23]

frameworks.pangaea: large only; band list has B10 not B9, although the modality is S2L2A (L2A has no B10) and TerraTorch S2L2A uses B9

models.name: DOFA
models.variants: base/16, large/16 (weights); small, huge in code; v2 checkpoints

inputs.band_identity: wavelength-conditioned (centre wavelength per channel, µm in TorchGeo; nm in Copernicus-Bench copy), shared across the batch
inputs.sar: placeholder wavelength for every SAR channel: 3.75 µm (TorchGeo, PANGAEA), 5.405 (README demo), 5.6 (GeoBreeze); VV and VH indistinguishable

licence.weights: conflict: CC-BY-4.0 (README) vs MIT (Hugging Face card)

inputs.band_identity: wavelength-conditioned, per sample: chn_ids (B,C) in nm; optional spectral response (mu, sigma); channel masks
inputs.sar: categorical ids encoding polarisation and orbit direction (−1…−12)
inputs.input_size: 224 trained; interpolation in original repo, fixed at init in TorchGeo

models.name: Copernicus-FM
models.variants: base, large (weights); small, huge in code

inputs.band_identity: wavelength + bandwidth per channel (nm), shared across batch; single-channel 'variable' mode via language embedding
inputs.sar: wavelength 5e7 nm, bandwidth 1e9 nm; VV and VH indistinguishable
inputs.units: S1 dB, S2 DN-scale, S3 scaled, S5P raw (per paper and bench configs)
inputs.patch_size: 16 base; kernel size is a forward argument
inputs.gsd_input: indirect: caller supplies patch-token area (km²) as meta[:,3]
inputs.location: meta = [lon, lat, days since 1970-01-01, patch area km²]; NaN = unknown

outputs.notes: one NaN in a batch switches the whole batch to the unknown token

models.name: AnySat
models.variants: base (weights); tiny, small defined without weights

inputs.input_size: square; equal ground extent across modalities

temporal.date_encoding: day of year per step: README says 0-based, demo uses tm_yday (1-based); no year

inputs.layout: dict {mod: B,T,C,H,W; mod_dates: B,T; mod_mask: 1 = valid}

outputs.type: tile (B,D), patch (B,n,n,D, channels-last in code; README says B,D,6,6), or dense (2·D channels)

inputs.band_identity: fixed band slots in four groups (space-time, space, time, static)
inputs.bands: S2: B2–B8, B8A, B11, B12 (L1C, S2_HARMONIZED); S1: VV, VH
inputs.units: S2 /1e4; S1 dB shifted; per-variable divisors

normalisation.stats: normalization.json; helper may silently skip it (string-key issue)

outputs.type: tokens per group and time; pooling helpers

models.name: SatlasPretrain (SatlasNet)
models.variants: 22 checkpoints: S2 SwinB/SwinT/ResNet50/ResNet152 × SI/MI × RGB/MS; S1, Landsat, Aerial SwinB × SI/MI

inputs.bands: S2 MS: TCI R,G,B then B05,B06,B07,B08,B11,B12; S1: VH, VV; Landsat B1–B11

temporal.native: MI variants: max-pool over up to 8 images

outputs.notes: FPN prepends a stride-1 map (5 outputs)

frameworks.pangaea: S2 SwinB SI/MI; band order and normalisation differ from Satlas; multi-image reshape is channel-major (B,C·T) while Satlas expects time-major, so bands and time steps are mixed when T>1

inputs.band_identity: wavelength-conditioned (µm), shared across batch; per-sensor metadata.yaml
inputs.sar: placeholder wavelengths: VV 3.5, VH 4.0 (so polarisations are distinguishable); linear in v1, dB in v1.5
inputs.layout: dict {pixels: B,C,H,W; time; latlon; gsd; waves}

outputs.type: CLS + patch tokens, final layer only

models.name: OSM embedding model (possibly SatOSM: UNVERIFIED)
models.variants: ViT-L/16 (DINOv2-style, with CLIP-style tag head); an HRNet-W64 config also exists

sensors: aerial RGB (Netherlands orthophotos in the data pipeline)

outputs.notes: confirm this is the SatOSM used in the lab's benchmarks
